image_policy: Current mainline uses frozen Zenodo ResNet18 oral-photo features and frozen external oral-cytology pretrained ResNet18 cell features. ImageNet cell features remain a control. Train projections, table and methylation encoders, Transformer and binary head.
scope: Research on master: external GSE204943 methylation pretraining plus external oral-cell pretraining. Five-fold single-model and six-fold mean-of-five evaluation entrypoints are selected through pretraining_mainline.json. Historical four-combination runner remains a control; no APP deployment or old test-set evaluation.
